item.text:
THOUGHT:
All three reviewers recommend rejection while agreeing that the arithmetic and least-squares derivation are correct. The decisive concern is the limited contribution: a standard intercept calculation is presented through one deterministic example, without evidence that its instructional organization improves learning. Constant residuals explain exact cancellation; using the same observations for estimation and scoring limits its interpretation as evaluation. The general mean-residual minimization identity remains valid for nonconstant residuals, although zero error does not. Reviewers differ on the adequacy of the in-sample caveat and figure provenance, so these should be treated as presentation concerns rather than established mathematical defects. The submission appears useful as introductory teaching material but does not establish a sufficient research contribution for a top-tier machine learning conference.
